name: OSINT core
description: Stable cross-domain entity and observable types available to every OSINT investigation.

entity_types.label: Person
entity_types.description: A specifically named natural person.

entity_types.label: Organization
entity_types.description: A named formal organization, institution, company, agency or association.

entity_types.label: Location
entity_types.description: A named geographic area, administrative region, settlement or physical place.

entity_types.label: Facility
entity_types.description: A named physical site with a specific operational function.

entity_types.label: Group
entity_types.description: A named informal collective that is not necessarily a formal organization.

entity_types.label: Event
entity_types.description: A named occurrence bounded in time or described as having happened.

entity_types.label: Program
entity_types.description: A named structured and continuing initiative or programme.

entity_types.label: Operation
entity_types.description: A named coordinated operation with an explicit objective.

entity_types.label: Campaign
entity_types.description: A named coordinated series of activities directed toward an objective.

entity_types.label: Document
entity_types.description: A named document, report, filing, record or documentary artifact.

entity_types.label: Media content
entity_types.description: A named article, post, image, video, audio item, broadcast or publication.

entity_types.label: Dataset
entity_types.description: A named database, register, corpus, leak or structured collection of data.

entity_types.label: Agreement
entity_types.description: A named contract, treaty, memorandum, concession or other agreement.

entity_types.label: Legal case
entity_types.description: A named judicial, regulatory, arbitration or administrative proceeding.

entity_types.label: Brand
entity_types.description: A named commercial or institutional brand.

entity_types.label: Product
entity_types.description: A named manufactured, commercial or published product.

entity_types.label: Service
entity_types.description: A named commercial, public or digital service.

entity_types.label: Software
entity_types.description: A named software application, platform, model or system.

entity_types.label: Device
entity_types.description: A specifically identified physical electronic or communications device.

entity_types.label: Asset
entity_types.description: A named asset that is not represented by a more specific core type.

entity_types.label: Infrastructure
entity_types.description: A named transport, energy, communications or other infrastructure system.

entity_types.label: Financial account
entity_types.description: A specifically identified bank, investment, exchange or other financial account.

entity_types.label: Domain
entity_types.description: An explicitly observed internet domain name.

entity_types.label: Hostname
entity_types.description: An explicitly observed host name.

entity_types.label: URL
entity_types.description: An explicitly observed web or network resource locator.

entity_types.label: Email address
entity_types.description: An explicitly observed email address.

entity_types.label: Phone number
entity_types.description: An explicitly observed telephone number.

entity_types.label: IP address
entity_types.description: An explicitly observed IP address.

entity_types.label: Username
entity_types.description: An explicitly observed username or handle without an identified account.

entity_types.label: Social account
entity_types.description: A specifically identified social-media profile or account.

entity_types.label: Online account
entity_types.description: A specifically identified non-social online account.

entity_types.label: File hash
entity_types.description: An explicitly observed cryptographic file digest.

entity_types.label: Cryptocurrency address
entity_types.description: An explicitly observed cryptocurrency address.

entity_types.label: IBAN
entity_types.description: An explicitly observed International Bank Account Number.

entity_types.label: License plate
entity_types.description: An explicitly observed vehicle registration plate.

entity_types.label: Vehicle
entity_types.description: A specifically identified land vehicle.

entity_types.label: Vessel
entity_types.description: A specifically identified maritime vessel.

entity_types.label: Aircraft
entity_types.description: A specifically identified aircraft.

entity_types.label: Passport number
entity_types.description: An explicitly observed passport identifier.

entity_types.label: National ID
entity_types.description: An explicitly observed national identity identifier.

entity_types.label: Tax identifier
entity_types.description: An explicitly observed tax or company fiscal identifier.
